title: When the Lights Go Down
lyrics:
[Intro — Electric Guitar]

[Verse 1 — Male]
There's a photograph beside my bed,
Of younger days and words unsaid.
The rain is falling on this town,
And every road keeps turning round.
I pass the places we once knew,
The little café painted blue.
The years have carried us apart,
But left your kindness in my heart.

[Verse 2 — Female]
I found your letter yesterday,
Between the things I packed away.
I read the lines beneath the light,
And smiled at who we were that night.
I never thought we'd lose our way,
Or have so many things to say.
But love can change and still be true,
To all the good we once lived through.

[Pre-Chorus — Alternating]
[Male] If I could turn the hands of time...
[Female] I'd leave the tears and keep the shine.
[Male] And all the roads we couldn't take...
[Female] Still led us somewhere, through the ache.

[Chorus — Together]
When the lights go down,
And the stars come shining out,
I can hear you through the years,
In the laughter and the tears.
We were fire, we were rain,
We were joy and we were pain.
Though the world has changed somehow,
Love still glows when the lights go down.

[Verse 3 — Call and Response]
[Male] Do you remember that old song?
[Female] The one we sang the whole night long?
[Male] I heard it playing yesterday.
[Female] I heard it too, so far away.
[Male] I hope your mornings find you well.
[Female] And yours have brighter tales to tell.
[Together] We found our lives on different roads,
But neither walks with empty hope.

[Instrumental — Expressive Electric Guitar Solo]

[Bridge]
[Male] I used to wish that you'd come home.
[Female] I used to fear I'd be alone.
[Male] But loving you was never wrong.
[Female] And letting go has made us strong.
[Together] Not every love is meant to stay,
Not every light must fade away.

[Final Chorus — Together]
When the lights go down,
And the stars come shining out,
We can hear across the years,
All the laughter, all the tears.
We were fire, we were rain,
We were joy and we were pain.
Though our lives have changed somehow,
Love still glows when the lights go down.
[Male] I won't ask you to return.
[Female] Some goodbyes are how we learn.
[Together] And every love that once was true,
Leaves a little light in me and you.

[Outro]
[Female] When the lights go down...
[Male] I wish you peace, wherever you are.
[Together] Somewhere beneath these same old stars.
notes: 72 BPM, E minor, 4/4. English-language mature male/female romantic duet. Male sings verse 1 alone; female sings verse 2 alone; alternating pre-chorus and verse 3; chorus in genuine two-part harmony, distinct voices, no vocal blending into one singer. Tasteful blues guitar intro and 16-bar expressive solo with bends, warm piano, subtle Hammond organ, round bass, restrained live drums. Bittersweet but hopeful; organic studio sound. Aim for full song around 4 minutes where supported. No spoken narration, no excessive vocal effects. All melody, vocals and arrangement original.
